race.description: Grid Property Group Super Showcase Mdn Plate
race.comment: WORLD WIDE (3) has the strongest exposed form, returning from a five-month break after being beaten a head at Kembla Grange, where he jumped awkwardly, was bumped, led and fought back hard. Recent trial was very impressive and he looks the one to beat coming back to country grade. TINTOELA (10) is the key debut danger, coming through four trials and having a sibling in The Unique Star who won on debut and later won in town. Needs a touch of luck from the barrier, but she's showing enough to suggest she can feature on debut. PASIFAE (8) resumed with a long-neck second at Gundagai, producing a good rating in the process. Can feature again here with natural improvement second-up. GITTYA OWN (9) debuts for Bjorn Baker off a comfortable Hawkesbury trial win, giving her enough readiness to be treated as a genuine chance despite no race experience.
